name: video_watermark
description: Put a logo image and/or a line of text on a video: branding, a title card, a caption or a call to action. Choose the position (corners, edges or center), margin, opacity and size, and optionally show it only between start and end. Text gets a soft background box for readability unless background is false.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

image.description: Logo or image to overlay (PNG with transparency works best), relative to the workspace.

position.description: Where to place it. Default bottom_right.

margin.description: Distance from the edges in pixels. Default 24.

size.description: Image width as a fraction of the video width (default 0.15), or text height as a fraction of the video height (default 0.05).

text_color.description: Text color: a name (white, yellow) or hex (#FFCC00). Default white.

background.description: Draw a translucent box behind the text. Default true.

start.description: Show it from this time. Default the beginning. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

end.description: Hide it after this time. Default the end. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_watermarked.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
